brief: A bead organizer that tucks two notch drawers into the corners where its bases meet.

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2, divided bins with small-part heaps; no bead props exist so screws/nuts/standoffs stand in

finish.summary: Triangular 3-base organizer with two notch drawer frames in the meeting corners and two divided bins for sorted beads (staged with small hardware heaps as bead stand-ins).

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
